title: A built site shows no template picture, masthead words or broken image where the business has its own
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A frame whose own pictures all had a hard fault shows an owner photo looked at as any real photo; a frame the kit cannot hide is never emptied; each kept page's masthead entry takes the written description and background; a heading printed as an alt, step 8's alt over the writer's, and a list sharing one value with a hidden tab's row no longer block the final check.

tests: a frame whose own pictures all have a hard fault shows a real photo of the business, looked at as any real photo
a frame the kit cannot hide keeps its demo picture and says so, never an empty picture tag
each kept page's masthead entry takes the default description and a written background
a heading the template prints as a picture's alt is not the writer's alt: not measured, with why
step 8's alt over the writer's words on that alt is the rule, not a dispute; the writer's words still lose
a list sharing one value with a row of a hidden tab is not that row: the row is not found, never a wrong count
